items.title: Iraq taps political newcomer al-Zaidi as prime minister-designate

featured_image.name: Iraq president nominates Ali al-Zaidi as PM-designate - Le Monde

items.description:
Iraqi President Nizar Amedi on Monday designated Ali al-Zaidi, a 40-year-old businessman and political newcomer, as prime minister-designate, tasking him with forming a new government after months of political deadlock and weeks of fraught negotiations shaped by American pressure.[1][2][3]

The appointment came on the final day of the constitutional deadline, after the Coordination Framework — a coalition of Shiite factions holding around 185 of parliament's 329 seats — endorsed al-Zaidi as its "consensus candidate" following a meeting at the government palace in Baghdad.[4][5]

items.title: First LNG tanker crosses Hormuz since Iran war began

featured_image.name: ADNOC LNG Tanker Crosses Strait Of Hormuz - Marine Link

items.description:
A liquefied natural gas tanker managed by the UAE's ADNOC has crossed the Strait of Hormuz and appeared off the west coast of India, ship-tracking data showed on Monday, in what would be the first loaded LNG tanker to transit the strait since the Iran war began on February 28.[1][2]

The 136,357-cubic-meter vessel was last seen in the Gulf on March 30 before reappearing near India after several weeks without a signal, according to data from ICIS LNG Edge, Marine Traffic and LSEG. Ships in the Gulf have increasingly resorted to evasive tactics, including stopping location transmissions or broadcasting false identification numbers, to avoid being targeted or detained.[2]
